name: eachlabs
description: Generate and edit images, video, music and voice with each::labs models, and run your organization's each::labs workflows, from a conversation. Sign in with your each::labs account; no API key needed. Needs Hermes Agent 0.23.2 or later. First add the server with `hermes mcp add eachlabs --url https://mcp.eachlabs.ai/mcp --auth oauth --connect-timeout 300`. Hermes turns on all each::labs tools. Keep the ones you need with `hermes mcp configure eachlabs`.
